16:55.text: which We have bestowed on them! Then enjoy yourselves
, but you will come to know

16:56.text: And they assign a portion of that which We have provided them unto what they know not
. By Allâh, you shall certainly be questioned about

16:57.text: And they assign daughters unto Allâh! - Glorified
is He above all that they associate with Him! And unto themselves what they desire;

16:58.text: is brought to any of them, his face becomes dark, and he is filled with inward grief!

16:59.text: He hides himself from the people because of the evil of that whereof he has been informed. Shall he keep her with dishonour or bury her in the earth

16:60.text: For those who believe not in the Hereafter is an evil description, and for Allâh is the highest description. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

16:61.text: And if Allâh were to seize mankind for their wrong-doing, He would not leave on it
creature, but He postpones them for an appointed term and when their term comes, neither can they delay nor can they advance it an hour

16:62.text: They assign to Allâh that which they dislike
, and their tongues assert the falsehood that the better things will be theirs. No doubt for them is the Fire, and they will be the first to be hastened on into it, and left there neglected.

16:63.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
made their deeds fair-seeming to them. So he
, and theirs will be a painful torment.

16:64.text: And We have not sent down the Book
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
, except that you may explain clearly unto them those things in which they differ, and
a guidance and a mercy for a folk who believe.
